## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL — mixed internals with no clear directional impulse. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; Technology, Healthcare and Industrials are the positives while Communication, Energy and Real Estate lag. Major divergence across mega-caps and mid-cap tech equipment leadership tempers conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology lead driven by semicap strength: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +11.86% | 1M: +23.36%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing broad support: LLY (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +8.55%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +12.71%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials showing rotation into cyclicals: CAT (1W: +8.20% | 1M: +21.58%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.70% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Real Estate, Communication and Energy are weakest: AMT (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -10.20% | 1M: -16.27%) BELOW TREND. Communication names under pressure: TMUS (1W: -9.12% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -9.25% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND. Energy showing broad weakness with XOM (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -5.88%) BELOW TREND and CVX (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -9.15%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +17.22% | 1M: +21.06%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +11.86% | 1M: +23.36%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +12.56%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology) — concentration risk present.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: CEG (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -13.69%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -18.85%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -9.12% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -9.25% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication and Real Estate.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +17.22% | 1M: +21.06%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND; flag TSLA (1W: +10.22% | 1M: -3.49%) in RECOVERY — short-term momentum versus 1M weakness. Market shows MAJOR Divergence among large caps (NVDA, GOOGL, META, AMZN, TSLA) — tactical setups, not broad-confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed: semicap/equipment leaders ABOVE TREND while several mega-cap software/hardware names are BELOW TREND or in RECOVERY. AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: -9.47% | 1M: -26.11%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -11.27% | 1M: -35.09%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -5.12%) RECOVERY. Sector showing internal rotation rather than uniform strength.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Mixed-to-weak on 1W but some leaders remain ABOVE TREND: V (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +3.97%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -2.04% | 1M: +9.36%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth is weak this week (Financials 1W: -1.30%), so pickivity advised.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Relatively constructive: LLY (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +8.55%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +12.71%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND. Watch headline-driven names (AMGN, MRK) for headline risk despite sector strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to semicap leaders and resilient healthcare/cyclicals: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +8.55%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +8.20% | 1M: +21.58%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to lagging Communication and legacy software names: TMUS (1W: -9.12% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -11.27% | 1M: -35.09%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat semiconductor strength as idiosyncratic rather than market-wide.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +8.55%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -11.27% | 1M: -35.09%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -9.47% | 1M: -26.11%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (semiconductor equipment cluster) — leadership concentrated but powerful. Healthcare remains constructive.  
BEARISH: Communication and Real Estate — monitor headline flow and earnings.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
AMAT above recent breakout (continue ABOVE TREND) signals momentum extension; NVDA needs follow-through above its short-term RECOVERY range to validate rotation to growth; JPM reclaiming 1M trend would resolve CORRECTION and signal re-risk into Financials.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LLY (+65): Medicare GLP-1 bridge program; LLY (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +8.55%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price.  
MA (+55): Stablecoin/backing headlines; MA (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +3.97%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming.  
CME (+55): CEO succession/new futures launch; CME (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -18.85%) BELOW TREND — positive news but price diverging, watch for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TMUS (-50): SpaceX phone disruption headline; TMUS (1W: -9.12% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming weakness.  
XOM (-45): Oil weakness pressuring margins; XOM (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -5.88%) BELOW TREND — sentiment in line with price decline.  
AMGN (-80): NEJM retraction headline; AMGN not among the top/bottom lists this week but headline risk merits monitoring for downside momentum.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership.  
AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +8.55%) showing strength.  
Key risk: MAJOR Divergence among mega-caps (NVDA, GOOGL, META, AMZN, TSLA in RECOVERY) and concentrated tech-equipment leadership — treat moves as tactical, not broad-confirmation.
